sentence: This project builds a system that schedules jobs on quantum computers so that noise in the machines does less harm.
This project designs a network of devices inside the body that collect their own energy to help manage chronic diseases.
This project builds bipedal robots that use perception to move quickly across irregular terrains.
This project uses artificial intelligence to develop materials and devices for electronics.
This project builds statistical and deep learning tools to forecast extreme events such as heat waves and wildfire outbreaks.
This project designs ways to protect machine learning models from privacy and security attacks.
This project studies how humidity makes microchip materials stick to manufacturing equipment.
This project studies how a protein on phages decides which bacteria the phages interact with.
This project acquires an imaging system that takes low-noise X-ray images of objects with complex geometries.
This project tries to find out how microbes change spilled crude oil in groundwater and how long the changed molecules last.
This project builds a web platform that uses deep learning to help researchers manage and analyze large sets of complex data.
This project builds AI tools that read single-cell data to tell tumor cells from normal cells and to understand how cancer evolves.
This project designs antenna arrays that change their active antennas to reduce interference, using deep learning.
This project builds a theory that links electric currents, magnetic fields, heat and the deformation of metals, and tests it with simulations.
This project builds a neural network that estimates motion in images taken from a long distance through turbulent air and water.
This project studies how the amount of entanglement in quantum states relates to how well quantum algorithms perform.
This project uses theory to study how fine-tuning works for large language models and how transfer learning affects generalization.
